review.tagline: RAG and enterprise search app templates built on the Pathway live data framework
review.summary: A set of Python templates for RAG and document search that stay in sync with sources such as local files, Google Drive, SharePoint, S3, Kafka and PostgreSQL. Indexing is built in (usearch for vectors, Tantivy for full-text), so no separate vector database, cache or API framework is needed. Templates include basic Q&A, multimodal GPT-4o parsing, unstructured-to-SQL, Adaptive RAG, a private Mistral/Ollama variant and video RAG, each exposing an HTTP API.
review.audience: Teams building live-synced RAG or document search backends in Python
strengths: Index updates on additions, deletions and edits in connected sources
Built-in vector, hybrid and full-text indexes, no external vector DB
Private template runs locally with Mistral and Ollama
Optional Streamlit UI for quick demos
weaknesses: Tied to the Pathway framework, so pipeline code is not portable
Several templates call hosted APIs (GPT-4o, TwelveLabs)
README gives no RAM or hardware requirements
needs: Needs Pathway, usearch, Tantivy, PostgreSQL (SQL template), Ollama (private template), TwelveLabs (video template), Streamlit (optional UI)
Models: OpenAI GPT-4o, Mistral via Ollama, TwelveLabs Pegasus and Marengo
